title: Night of the Network Map
premise: A long drama of subway network map design. A-He and A-Wei are easily confused; the network master map goes intact→ink-bled→redrawn; the folding measuring wheel is crushed and must be avoided; count memory, false friends, and temporal flashbacks run throughout. Human-readable context only; never fed to the SUT.
_comment: Author layer: humans only write entities + state machines + per-scene timelines (present + handwritten action + semantic events). present items may be objects carrying confusable_with/count/anchor metadata. op/gap/probe/forbidden are derived by complete_gt.py.
_state_note: Stateful entities use states; stateless use appearance. On transition inject only the current state's appearance.

states.prime_on_duty: Subway network designer Lu Heng around thirty-five, neat short hair, deep-blue work shirt with a scale pin on the cuff, fingertips often stained with highlighter ink, sharp gaze.
states.weary_injured: The same Lu Heng weary and injured: work shirt torn at a corner, gauze on the brow, still wearing the scale pin, heavy steps.
states.left_post: Lu Heng has left his post; only his deep-blue old work clothes and badge remain in the drafting room—he himself no longer appears.

states.young_apprentice: Young A-He: a lean drafting apprentice around fifteen, turmeric armband on the left arm, knuckles white when gripping a pen, bright stubborn eyes.
states.adult_successor: Adult A-He: a tall upright successor drafter in his twenties, still in turmeric armband, calm eyes.

states.intact: A full-wall city subway network master map, colored lines crossing, transfer nodes marked with magnets, surface flat unmarked.
states.ink_bled: The same network master map stained by a spilled inkbottle in purple-black blooms; many colored lines smear together, transfer nodes hard to read.
states.redrawn: After redrawing, the network master map's colored lines are clear again, but a shallow patch mark remains at the lower right, apart from the first intact state.

states.intact: A deep-blue leather transfer notebook, pages packed with station-spacing sketches and ridership curves, clean corners.
states.coffee_stained: The same transfer notebook soaked by spilled coffee, cover warped, page writing bled, a crumpled blotter sheet tucked inside.

states.intact: A foldable yellow-and-black measuring wheel, centimeter marks on the rim, handle wrapped in nonslip tape.
states.crushed: The folding measuring wheel crushed by a construction truck, rim split, marks twisted—only a skewed wreck remains.

states.young_rival: A-Wei nearly identical in face and build to A-He, but an amber brooch at the collar, bold and quick to interrupt.
states.disguised: Disguised A-Wei still wears the amber brooch, plus thin-frame glasses, expression deeper.

E7.name: transfer-center drafting room
E7.appearance: The second-floor drafting room of the transfer center, four whiteboard walls packed with network drafts, highlighters and T-squares on the long table, station-hall glass dome beyond the window.

E8.name: station-hall mockup zone
E8.appearance: An unopened station-hall mockup zone, floor tiles unfinished, temporary station-name stickers on columns, cement smell in the air.

E9.name: construction corridor
E9.appearance: A narrow construction corridor to the shield shaft, cable reels and hard hats stacked on both sides, emergency lights stretching long shadows.

E10.name: abandoned platform site
E10.appearance: An abandoned platform site unused for years, moss on the platform edge, rusted ticket gates half open.

E11.name: brass station-name plaque
E11.appearance: A brass station-name plaque nailed to an abandoned-platform column, engraved with 'Lu Heng' and the year, edges already verdigrised.

E12.name: transfer-node magnets
E12.appearance: Three red-and-white transfer-node magnets with magnetic backs, used to mark key transfer stations on the network master map.

E13.name: plastic demo cart
E13.appearance: A plastic demo cart somewhat like a measuring tool but without a marked rim, body printed 'For Display'.

E14.name: network supervisor Lao Jin
E14.appearance: Network supervisor Lao Jin somewhat resembling Lu Heng in build, gray uniform, silver stars on the shoulder, gear badge on the cap instead of a scale.

E15.name: drafting desk lamps
E15.appearance: A row of five drafting desk lamps with flexible arms, milky shades, screwed to the drafting-room long-table edge, numbers written inside the shades.

E16.name: platform announce bells
E16.appearance: Two copper platform announce bells taken from an old station, hung by the drafting-room window frame, giving a clear short tone when tapped.

E17.name: intern Xiaoqiao
E17.appearance: Intern Xiaoqiao who at a glance resembles young A-He, light-gray hair ribbon instead of turmeric armband, shy gaze, soft voice.

E18.name: pocket schematic puzzle
E18.appearance: A desktop-sized pocket schematic puzzle whose colored-line layout closely resembles the network master map, but no real station names, cardboard edges.

E19.name: blue-gray inspection cart
E19.appearance: A strange blue-gray inspection battery cart, broad flat bed, no measuring wheel, 'Equipment Section' sprayed on the side door.

features.E2: A-He: turmeric armband, calm or stubborn eyes.
features.E6: A-Wei: face nearly identical to A-He, but amber brooch at the collar, bold or deep expression.

lookalike_pairs.note: Hard confuse sample: A-He and A-Wei look alike; distinguished only by turmeric armband / amber brooch.

scenes.setting: Drafting room at dusk (introduce five drafting desk lamps · two announce bells)
actions: At dusk, Lu Heng opens the transfer-center drafting room door and sets a T-square on the long table.

actions.action: A row of five drafting desk lamps is screwed along the long table; Lu Heng lights each and wipes dust inside the shades.
By the window frame hang two copper platform announce bells; Lu Heng taps them with a knuckle, short tones echoing off the whiteboard walls.

actions: Lu Heng rises on tiptoe to check the line width of every transfer color on the network master map.
By the window Lu Heng watches dimming sky light beyond the station-hall glass dome.

actions.action: The intact network master map covers the whole wall; colored lines gleam faintly under the drafting desk lamps.

actions: With a highlighter Lu Heng adds an unopened branch line on the whiteboard.
Lu Heng unpins and re-pins the scale pin on his cuff, habitually checking the marks.
Lu Heng sorts scattered color cards and reorders them by line number.
Lu Heng sits on a drafting-room tall stool and rubs his aching neck.

scenes.setting: Recording the transfer notebook
actions: Lu Heng opens the deep-blue leather transfer notebook and records today's ridership spot-checks.
In the transfer notebook Lu Heng draws a walking-minutes curve between two stations.
Lu Heng closes the transfer notebook and tucks it into the long-table drawer.

actions.action: Colored-line gleam from the network master map sweeps Lu Heng's profile.

actions: Against the network master map Lu Heng circles congested transfer points in red.
Lu Heng caps spare highlighters tight so the tips will not dry.

scenes.setting: Mockup zone meets the apprentice (introduce three magnets)
actions: In the morning station-hall mockup zone, Lu Heng greets young A-He pushing the folding measuring wheel in.

actions.action: A-He steadies the folding measuring wheel and pats cement dust from the rim.
Lu Heng points to three red-and-white transfer-node magnets, teaching A-He which transfer stations each marks.
A-He crouches by unfinished floor tiles, curiously touching temporary station-name stickers on a column.
Lu Heng explains to A-He the scale difference between the mockup zone and a real station hall.
A-He looks back at the intact folding measuring wheel, eyes full of longing.
Lu Heng has A-He push the folding measuring wheel once around the mockup zone and record wheel turns.
A-He cinches the turmeric armband and carefully notes the station spacings Lu Heng dictates.

scenes.setting: Construction corridor (A-Wei alone)
actions: In the construction corridor, A-Wei with an amber brooch at the collar turns to look from behind a cable reel.
A-Wei strides the construction corridor, boldly swinging a hard hat.
A-Wei brushes past a materials cart; the amber brooch sways under emergency light.
A-Wei stops at the shield-shaft mouth, pickily criticizing fonts on temporary guide signs.
A-Wei peels an extra station-name sticker and sticks it crooked again.
A-Wei passes through the construction-corridor crowd and vanishes around a corner.

scenes.setting: Mockup zone: A-He and A-Wei co-present
actions: In the station-hall mockup zone, A-He and A-Wei stand side by side—one turmeric armband, one amber brooch.
A-He hands A-Wei a found color card; they look at each other with different expressions.
A-Wei straightens A-He's turmeric armband, then deliberately clicks her amber brooch.
A-He and A-Wei walk slowly along the unfinished platform edge; shadows overlap then part.
A-He looks down to check a sketch; A-Wei snaps photos everywhere.
A-He and A-Wei part at the mockup-zone mouth, each walking opposite ways.

scenes.setting: Drafting-room night shift (notebook coffee-stained)
actions: Months later at night, Lu Heng keeps watch alone in the drafting room; the network master map hangs quiet on the wall.

actions.action: Lu Heng opens the transfer notebook and finds spilled coffee has warped the cover and bled the writing.

actions: Lu Heng wipes a thin chalk dust from the network master map surface.
By the drafting-room window Lu Heng gazes at the empty station-hall dome.

actions.action: Light spots from the drafting desk lamps drift slowly across the network master map.

actions: Lu Heng slips blotter paper into the stained transfer notebook, sighs, and turns out the light.

scenes.setting: Network reroute week (filler)
actions: On a reroute-week morning, Lu Heng erases old branch-line drafts from the whiteboard.
With cyan-green highlighter Lu Heng redraws a parallel express-line sketch.
Lu Heng presses a T-square along the whiteboard's lower edge to keep the baseline level.
Against the network master map Lu Heng checks crossings of the new express line with the existing loop.
In the afternoon Lu Heng takes a dispatch call in the drafting room, brows slightly furrowed.
On a sticky note Lu Heng writes 'delay opening' and sticks it to a whiteboard corner.
Lu Heng rearranges color cards and pulls the express-line color aside alone.
At dusk Lu Heng switches off spare lamps, leaving only the center one on the network master map.

scenes.setting: Ridership-marking ten-day stretch (filler)
actions: In the ridership-marking stretch, Lu Heng hangs transparent tracing paper beside the network master map.
With orange dots Lu Heng marks congested morning-peak transfer nodes.
Lu Heng fixes tracing-paper edges with magnetic strips against curling.
Against stained pages in the transfer notebook Lu Heng struggles to read old numbers.
Lu Heng sets a fresh cup of tea farther away, afraid of spilling on the notebook again.
On the whiteboard Lu Heng lists three proposed last-train time adjustments.
Outside the drafting-room window a trial train rumbles; Lu Heng looks up and listens a moment.
With thin cord Lu Heng restrings color cards by line number.

scenes.setting: Station-hall patrol day (filler · no magnets)
actions: On station-hall patrol day, Lu Heng puts on a hard hat and walks into the station-hall mockup zone.
Lu Heng tests unset tile adhesive with a toe.
Lu Heng notes where column stickers have peeled.
With a flashlight Lu Heng shines into an unpowered sign lightbox.
At the mockup-zone entrance Lu Heng talks briefly with the construction foreman.
Lu Heng skirts stacked cable reels and rounds to the other platform.
With a tape Lu Heng measures reserved fare-gate width.
Lu Heng writes the measurements on a cuff sticky note.

scenes.setting: Mockup patrol (recall magnets · plastic-demo-cart false friend)
actions: At dawn, Lu Heng patrols the station-hall mockup zone; the folding measuring wheel leans by a column.

actions.action: Lu Heng crouches to check whether the folding measuring wheel rim marks are worn.
Lu Heng walks to a temporary bench; those three transfer-node magnets are still lined up neat.
A plastic demo cart printed 'For Display' is pushed through the mockup zone—no marked rim, never a folding measuring wheel.
Lu Heng stands in the mockup zone, logging unfinished tile gaps.
Lu Heng pushes the folding measuring wheel to a drier corner and stands it upright.
Lu Heng confirms again that none of the three transfer-node magnets is missing.
On a whiteboard at the mockup-zone exit Lu Heng writes the patrol date.

scenes.setting: Eve of storm standby (filler)
actions: On the eve of a storm, Lu Heng shelves all drafts near the drafting-room window.
Lu Heng covers the lower edge of the network master map with waterproof cloth against damp climbing the wall.
Lu Heng checks that the transfer notebook is in a dry drawer.
Lu Heng tightens the inkbottle cap and moves it to a high shelf.
Distant thunder rolls; drafting-room fluorescents flicker once.
Lu Heng neats the cords of five drafting desk lamps to avoid trips.
On the whiteboard Lu Heng drafts a 'stop work tomorrow' notice.
Lu Heng listens whether the announce bells by the window frame ring in the wind.

scenes.setting: Storm night (map ink · measuring wheel crushed)
actions: A storm rises suddenly; the drafting-room roof leaks; drops smash onto the desk.
A draft through the room lifts tracing paper; the inkbottle rocks toward a tip.

actions.action: The inkbottle finally tips; purple-black ink blooms; large stretches of colored lines on the network master map smear into one blot.
In the station-hall mockup zone the folding measuring wheel still stands by an unfinished roadway.
A runaway construction truck rolls over it; the folding measuring wheel rim splits—only a skewed wreck remains.
In the drafting room Lu Heng lunges to the wall and presses bare hands on the blooming network master map.
A falling lamp shade splits Lu Heng's brow; blood soaks gauze, yet he still shields the map face.
The ink-bled network master map slowly sags at one corner in the damp air.

scenes.setting: Aftermath (wheel indirect cue · lamp recall)

actions.action: The day after the storm, Lu Heng stands in the drafting room staring at the ink-bled network master map.
Lu Heng runs a finger over purple-black blooms on the network master map, face dark.
On the drafting-room progress board Lu Heng records the date the folding measuring wheel was crushed.
An old photo of the folding measuring wheel still nails the drafting-room wall; Lu Heng gazes a long time.
Lu Heng lights one of the five drafting desk lamps on the wall and sits alone in its spot.
The damaged network master map still hangs on the wall; gaps in the colored lines shock the eye.
Lu Heng changes the bloodied gauze and keeps clearing desk glass shards.
Lu Heng resets the waterproof cloth, fearing damp will invade the network master map again.

scenes.setting: Cleanup and requisition (filler · damaged map still present)
actions: In cleanup week, Lu Heng packs shattered shade shards into a paper box.
Lu Heng submits a requisition to Equipment for redraw materials.
Every day Lu Heng still comes to the drafting room, staring blankly at the ink-bled network master map.
On transparent paper Lu Heng pencils still-readable line segments.
Lu Heng turns the stained transfer notebook to a blank page and switches to logging requisition progress.
A-He is on leave; only Lu Heng's footsteps remain in the drafting room.
Lu Heng hangs his hard hat back by the door and habitually touches the empty measuring-wheel bay.
On the whiteboard Lu Heng lists color numbers needed for redrawing.

scenes.setting: Redrawing the master map (third state · pocket-puzzle false friend)
actions: Weeks later, Lu Heng brings paints and new tracing paper and begins redrawing the network master map.

actions.action: From a carton Lu Heng takes a pocket schematic puzzle; it closely resembles the network master map, yet is smaller and has no real station names.

actions: Lu Heng carefully patches along bloom edges and redraws colored lines.

actions.action: The last colored line joins; the network master map is clear again, a shallow patch mark at the lower right.

actions: The redrawn network master map is readable again under the lights; Lu Heng watches it with relief.

actions.action: Lu Heng pushes the pocket schematic puzzle aside and pins only the true network master map back in place.
The drafting room grows quiet; the redrawn network master map alone owns the whole wall.

scenes.setting: False friends: inspection cart and network supervisor

actions.action: A blue-gray inspection cart enters the station-hall mockup zone, nothing like the long-crushed folding measuring wheel.
Silver-starred network supervisor Lao Jin walks into the mockup zone and talks beside Lu Heng; the two are similar in build.
Lao Jin points at the blue-gray inspection cart, explaining the new patrol-section plan to Lu Heng.
The cart sounds its horn and leaves; Lu Heng alone in the mockup zone watches it go.
The blue-gray inspection cart pauses briefly at a far platform, then continues on.
Before leaving, Lao Jin pats Lu Heng's shoulder; the gear badge on his cap flashes under the light.

scenes.setting: False friend: intern Xiaoqiao who resembles A-He

actions.action: Into the mockup zone comes intern Xiaoqiao in a light-gray hair ribbon; at a glance she somewhat resembles young A-He.
Xiaoqiao practices pushing a demo cart; Lu Heng shakes his head—she is not A-He after all.
Xiaoqiao shyly asks about station-name spelling; Lu Heng answers briefly and sends her to the materials store.
Lu Heng stands alone in the mockup zone, staring blankly at the empty measuring-wheel bay.

scenes.setting: Quiet ten days after redraw (filler · stretch the gap)
actions: In the first ten days after redraw, each morning Lu Heng first wipes the network master map's patch edges.
Lu Heng registers new color numbers on blank pages of the stained transfer notebook.
Lu Heng refuses to set ink on the desk edge again.
Lu Heng checks express-line delay-opening notice copy with the construction crew.
In the drafting room Lu Heng practices drawing arcs with a steadier hand.
Afternoon sun through the dome falls on the redrawn network master map.
Lu Heng polishes the announce bells but does not ring them yet, afraid of startling his thoughts.
Lu Heng receives a postcard from A-He but leaves it unopened under a lamp base.

scenes.setting: Year-end closing (filler)
actions: At year-end closing, Lu Heng binds a year's tracing paper by month.
Lu Heng bags the coffee-stained transfer notebook alone into an archive pouch.
Lu Heng prints before-and-after redraw photos and clips them into the archive.
Lu Heng clears the long table, leaving only a T-square and one drafting lamp.
Lu Heng oils the scale pin lightly against rust.
Beside the network master map's lower-right patch Lu Heng signs a date.
Fine snow drifts outside; drafting-room heat ticks softly.
Lu Heng finishes the annual summary; the cover says only 'Network'.
Lu Heng replaces the hard-hat liner with a new one.

scenes.setting: Twilight years (Lu Heng injured · announce-bell long-range recall)

actions.action: Years later at dusk, Lu Heng with a brow scar and heavy steps leans on a measuring rod at the abandoned platform site.

actions: Lu Heng looks up at rusted ticket gates, gaze far away.

actions.action: By the abandoned platform he has brought those two copper platform announce bells and hung them on a post; they ring softly in the wind.

actions: Lu Heng lays a palm on the mossy platform edge, as if saying goodbye.

actions.action: Lu Heng slowly sits on stone steps by the rusted gates and catches his breath.
The two platform announce bells ring softly again; Lu Heng closes his eyes to listen, as if hearing old departure cues.

scenes.setting: Old-site lingering stretch (filler · injured state continues)
actions: Every day Lu Heng still returns to the drafting room, but spends more time sitting and watching the network master map.
Lu Heng leans the measuring rod by the door; he moves slower than before.
Lu Heng lets a young assistant write the whiteboard and only checks.
Lu Heng photographs the redrawn network master map for distant A-He.
On the stained notebook's last page Lu Heng writes 'handover' without signing.
Lu Heng refuses hospital stays and insists on sitting weekly at the abandoned platform site.
Lu Heng wipes a draft of the brass station-name plaque, still undecided where to nail it.
At night only one lamp remains in the drafting room; Lu Heng dozes in its circle.
Lu Heng packs a spare turmeric armband strip for whoever returns.

scenes.setting: A-He returns · Lu Heng exits

actions.action: By day, adult A-He returns along the abandoned platform site and hurries toward the rusted gates.

actions: At the old site A-He reunites with heavy-stepping Lu Heng; the two embrace.

actions.action: Beside a camp cot in the drafting room, A-He holds Lu Heng's gaunt hand.
Lu Heng's breath fades; at last he closes his eyes and passes away.
A-He stands long at the abandoned platform site; tears fall on the moss.
A-He pins Lu Heng's scale pin to his own cuff.

scenes.setting: Relics · plaque (indirect cue for the deceased)

actions.action: Lu Heng's deep-blue old work clothes still hang behind the drafting-room door; A-He reaches out and gently strokes them.
By an abandoned-platform column, adult A-He stands before a newly nailed brass station-name plaque.
A-He's fingertips brush Lu Heng's name engraved on the plaque.
A-He sets a white chrysanthemum at the lower edge of the brass station-name plaque.
Wind crosses the old site; A-He softly speaks the year on the plaque.

scenes.setting: A-He and A-Wei reunite (adult confuse + co-present)

actions.action: Adult A-Wei in thin-frame glasses arrives from the station and embraces A-He tightly at the abandoned platform site.

actions: A-He and A-Wei stand side by side by the plaque—one calm-eyed, one deep in expression.
A-Wei touches her amber brooch, then looks at the scale pin on A-He's cuff.
Sister-like, the two look at each other without words, at faces alike yet different.
A-He and A-Wei walk together to the old platform's end; shadows merge into one.

scenes.setting: Memory flashback (temporal grounding · no names throughout)

actions.action: The shot returns to years ago—the youth in a turmeric armband pushing a measuring wheel in the mockup zone appears again.

anchor.phrase: the youth in a turmeric armband in the mockup zone

actions.action: The opening moment returns—in the drafting room, a wall of crossing colored lines is nailed up for the first time.

anchor.phrase: the network wall map first nailed up at the opening

actions.action: Flash back to that year's construction corridor—a figure with an amber brooch at the collar swinging a hard hat flashes by.

anchor.phrase: the figure with an amber brooch in that year's construction corridor

actions.action: Before the eyes again: that row of five old milky-shade work lamps along the drafting-room long table.

anchor.phrase: that row of five old work lamps along the drafting-room long table

actions.action: Back to the unfinished-tile mockup hall of first meeting; the cement smell is as it always was.

anchor.phrase: the unfinished-tile mockup hall of first meeting

actions.action: A page turns—that deep-blue leather notebook still without coffee stains, packed with station-spacing sketches, appears again.

anchor.phrase: the deep-blue leather notebook still without coffee stains

scenes.setting: Close (stained notebook long-range · magnets long-range)

actions.action: A-He opens that coffee-stained transfer notebook again and walks into the drafting room.
On the drafting-room bench, those three red-and-white transfer-node magnets are still neat.
A-He takes up the watch of the network master map; the patch mark is clear under the lights.
A-He lights five drafting desk lamps; light again covers the long table.
A-He stands straight before the redrawn network master map and begins checking colored lines as Lu Heng once did.
